question: Do existing primary reference constructions simultaneously provide role-separated two-pNGB electroweak doublets and explicit SO(10)-organized composite/GUT matching sufficient to derive heavy portals to protected I?

sources.frozen_fact: SO(6)->SO(4)xSO(2) yields two pNGB electroweak doublets with a resonance-based composite-sector potential, but this reference does not specify the FToE SO(10) heavy-scalar matching Lagrangian.

The minimal composite-GUT construction uses SO(11)->SO(10); its ten pNGBs transform as a 10 of SO(10), decomposing into one electroweak (1,2,2)_0 fourplet plus coloured triplet partners, not two independent electroweak doublet roles.

smallest_missing_input: An explicit versioned interaction/matching Lagrangian that simultaneously retains distinct SM-Higgs and protected-I electroweak doublets and specifies their couplings or sequestering with the SO(10)-breaking 210_H, 45_H, 126_H and 10_C,H sectors.
fail_closed_boundaries: Do not set unspecified heavy portals to zero.
Do not assume order-one heavy portals without an explicit interaction basis.
Do not transfer the SO(11)/SO(10) single-doublet result into the SO(6) two-doublet model by notation similarity.
Do not promote protected-I radiative stability or publication readiness from source proximity alone.
Preserve all predecessor PASS, FAIL and REVIEW records unchanged.
